Butland 2008.conclusion: NOT SUBSUMED, and the retrieval blocker is resolved. The served GeneInteractionBabu2014Dataset carries 727 of this paper's measurements under GeneInteractionPhenotype.screen_id == 'Butland et al.', which is 0.23 percent of the 314847 interaction scores Supplementary Table 4 releases without any filtering, over 160563 distinct gene pairs once the two Keio isolates of a gene are collapsed. Babu's release is the high-confidence tail of a re-analysis, not a superset of this one: it re-publishes 1129 rows over these 39 donors, and leaves 490 of this paper's own 1270 high-confidence gene pairs out.
Butland 2008.loadable_slice: 321 of the 799 non-essential high-confidence pairs are absent from Babu's released Table S2 altogether, and the unfiltered Supplementary Table 4 matrix holds 314847 S scores against 727 served records. Both slices load against the existing GeneInteractionPhenotype with no schema change, because Babu's own GI score IS this S score for the pairs the two releases share (793 of 873 matched rows are identical). The 489 SPA-tag essential pairs stay blocked on the hypomorph perturbation leaf the Babu loader already filed.

Schmidt 2022 nitrogen.conclusion: SUBSUMED for every sole-nitrogen-source condition the paper reports, and the mapping is a bijection, not a sample. Table 1 enumerates 52 nitrogen sources; the compendium's nitrogen source group holds exactly 52 conditions and 104 samples, every condition is one of this paper's compounds and every compound is one of those conditions, with the biological duplicate the Methods state. The served RbTnseqBorchert2024Dataset carries all 104 of those samples as 492128 records, 4732 loci each, so a loader for this row would store every one of them a second time. No loader.
Schmidt 2022 nitrogen.loadable_slice: NOT total, and the gap is not loadable either. The 19 amino-acid drop-out conditions of Table 1 have no condition in the compendium's nitrogen-source group at all, and by this paper's own t-SNE Methods it ran 129 sole-nitrogen-source growth assays over 51 conditions against the 102 samples the compendium carries over those same conditions, so 27 replicate assays are absent as well. Neither slice is recoverable: this paper released no per-gene data file, its supplemental material is one figure PDF, and its only release is the Fitness Browser, which answers https://fit.genomics.lbl.gov/cgi-bin/org.cgi?orgId=Putida with the status recorded in release_probes. Unlike Borchert 2023, whose own SI carries per-replicate fitness for the loci the compendium eliminated, there are no bytes here to load.

Thompson 2020 fatty acid and alcohol.conclusion: SUBSUMED. Every one of the 23 carbon sources the Results enumerate is a condition of the compendium's carbon source group, which holds 47 samples at them, 22 of the 23 in exactly the biological duplicate the Methods state. The served RbTnseqBorchert2024Dataset carries all 47 of those samples as 222404 records, 4732 loci each, so a loader for this row would store every one of them a second time. No loader.
Thompson 2020 fatty acid and alcohol.loadable_slice: Nothing, and that is measured rather than assumed. No condition this paper reports is missing from the compendium's carbon-source group, so unlike Schmidt 2022 there is not even a condition-level gap. The only slice the compendium is known to drop is the set of loci it eliminated for lacking a value in some sample, and this paper released no per-gene data file to recover them from: its supplemental material is one figure PDF and its only release is the Fitness Browser, which answers https://fit.genomics.lbl.gov/cgi-bin/org.cgi?orgId=Putida with the status recorded in release_probes. Borchert 2023's own SI carried per-replicate fitness, which is why that row became a loader; this one has no such bytes.
